title: Replace the SF Symbol icon with a designed Beadle mark
objective: Give Beadle its own mark, designed against the size it is actually seen at. The shipped menu bar icon is circle.hexagongrid.fill, a cluster of discs that merges into an indistinct smudge below roughly 20px. Replace it with a flat-top hexagon carrying three hexagonal beads punched through it, drawn in Swift as a template image so macOS tints and inverts it like any other status item, and ship the matching app icon, README lockup and social preview.
acceptance_criteria: The menu bar icon is a template image drawn in Swift, so it tints, inverts and highlights with the menu bar instead of being a fixed bitmap or a bundled resource.
The mark stays legible at 16px: its silhouette remains distinct where the previous hexgrid symbol merges into a disc.
The app bundle carries an AppIcon.icns declared by CFBundleIconFile and copied in by scripts/build-app.sh.
README and social preview assets carry the wordmark as outlines, so no asset depends on a font being installed.
The mark's geometry exists as regenerable source under design/, not only as exported binaries.
swift build and git diff --check pass.
